question: Does one-step temporal group selection preserve or improve P20 ranking relative to the 17-feature manual boosting baseline on a subsequently frozen temporal holdout?
rationale: Pilot-informed comparison added to satisfy the central assignment criterion. Development fixed-representation results have been inspected; final outcomes have not been computed by this stage.

estimand.information_boundary: Strictly earlier recorded events, including earlier holdout events; no target/equal-time inclusion
estimand.evidence_boundary: One development-adaptive study with subsequent holdout; no preregistration or independent cohort claim

decision_rule.interpretation: Report estimate and interval; positive lower limit supports gain on this holdout, lower limit above -0.005 supports the chosen limited tolerance. Otherwise inconclusive or a measured loss. Do not select winners after inspecting test.
decision_rule.cost_boundary: Search candidate fits, finalist fitting/application, materialization and sampled process RSS distinguished.
